items.description: Leak detection call-out
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(e) covers the investigation necessary to locate the source of damage; reference case 20 shows t >= 481 for a similar call-out.

items.description: Electro-acoustic pinpointing of the leak beneath the kitchen sink
items.rationale: Covered as part of necessary leak detection under 7.1.7(e); reference case 20 shows t >= 707 for a similar detection line.

items.description: Moisture measurement of the kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Covered as necessary measurement to establish extent of moisture per 7.1.7(e); reference case 20 includes this in the main detection line.

items.description: Service technician hours
items.rationale: Labour for leak detection is included in the flat-rate detection lines per 7.1.7(g) and reference case 20; separate hours are not indemnified.

items.description: Vehicle costs
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(f) allows one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice; reference case 18 shows t >= 68 for vehicle costs.

items.description: Freeing the affected pipe run beneath the kitchen sink
items.rationale: Necessary preparatory work for repair of affected part, covered under 7.1.7(a); reference case 18 supports inclusion.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Removal/disposal of affected material is covered under 7.1.7(a); reference case 18 shows t >= 57 for similar disposal.

items.description: Repair of the confirmed leak and replacement copper pipe section with standard insulation
items.rationale: Direct repair of insured pipework and replacement of affected section is covered under 7.1.1(b); reference case 18 shows t >= 221 for similar work.

items.description: Room drying line item for the roof space (Dachstuhl)
items.rationale: No damage to the roof space is described or evidenced; 7.1.5 excludes work beyond affected parts. Reference case 20: t = 0 for unrelated drying.

items.description: Condensation dryer (kitchen)
items.rationale: Drying equipment for affected kitchen area is covered under 7.1.7(b); reference case 20 shows t below 200 for similar drying.

items.description: Room drying of the kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Drying of affected kitchen floor/wall base is covered under 7.1.7(b); reference case 20 shows t below 200 for similar drying.

items.description: Transition pieces and standard insulation for the repaired section
items.rationale: Consumables and insulation for the repaired pipe are covered under 7.1.7(c); reference case 18 supports inclusion.

items.description: Final site cleaning of the covered work area
items.rationale: Final cleaning of the work area is not indemnified unless it is removal of debris (7.1.8(a)); reference case 18: t below 60 for cleaning/disinfection.

items.description: Vehicle costs
items.rationale: One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference case 18: t >= 68.

items.description: Removal of the water-damaged wooden kitchen table
items.rationale: Removal of a furnishing item destroyed by the insured event is covered under 7.1.7(h); reference case 12 supports inclusion.

items.description: Transport and disposal of the damaged table
items.rationale: Transport/disposal of destroyed furnishing item is covered under 7.1.7(h); reference case 12 supports inclusion.

items.description: Supply of replacement kitchen table, comparable specification to the original
items.rationale: Furnishing item destroyed by insured event, with new-for-old option in force (4.4, 7.1.1(d)); indemnity is full replacement price incl. VAT. EUR 440 + 19% VAT = EUR 523.60.

items.description: Delivery of the replacement table
items.rationale: Delivery of replacement furnishing item is covered under 7.1.7(h); reference case 12 supports inclusion.

items.description: Assembly and cleaning of the installation area
items.rationale: Assembly of replacement furnishing item is covered under 7.1.7(h); cleaning is only covered if directly related to the replacement. Reference case 12 supports inclusion.

items.description: Vehicle costs
items.rationale: One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference case 18: t >= 68.

items.description: Vehicle costs – return visit
items.rationale: Only one travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)); reference case 11: t = 0 for return visit.

items.description: Inspection of further furniture items stored in the garden for moisture
items.rationale: Inspection of items not affected by the insured event or not in the insured location is not covered (7.1.8(f)); reference case 11: t = 0 for similar inspection.
